hypothesis: The deployed policy executes only the first 15 of 50 predicted actions. Ordinary H50 mean flow can reward corrections outside the executed prefix. Optimize ZeVA's connected residual-on PI05 flow on H15 while leaving the already trained Base action path and its H50 loss unchanged.
preserve_hinge: Original sampled H50 hinge retained; action expert receives only residual-off H50 gradients and learning rate zero.
inference: Unchanged H50 output, execute first H15, task-language retrieval, recurrent phase, ZTE/bank/VLM frozen, three Large_D435 cameras, Joint14 to relative EEF16.
pretraining_checks: PI05 raw H50 equals ordinary PI05Policy H50 on a real batch
connected H15 flow backpropagates to ZeVA and never updates action expert
four-rank one-step smoke with TorchCodec and torch.compile
offline_selection: At fixed steps 500 and 1000, compare on, own off and frozen Base on the same full 5874-decision validation5 set, batch16, seed1000 and identical sample order/noise. Choose the earliest checkpoint with strictly lower H15 on than both controls. If neither passes, stop without formal rollout. H50 validation loss does not select the checkpoint.
formal_evaluation: Use the already frozen ten-task × 20 expert-valid-seed manifest, seen instructions, demo_randomized equivalent environment, H50/H15, full video/result audit, paired Base and ZeVA. No test-label selection of checkpoint, task, seed or gate. Target ZeVA at least 8 additional successes out of 200 episodes (4 percentage points); report per-task counts and paired uncertainty.
known_limit: Offline H15 improvement is a screening gate, not a guarantee of closed-loop success. Latest completed formal result is Base=110/200, ZeVA=110/200.
